import json,subprocess,sys,hashlib
from datetime import datetime,timezone
c=json.load(sys.stdin);k=c['kafka']
def run(args,body=None):
 r=subprocess.run(args,input=body,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=c['timeout_seconds'],check=True)
 return r.stdout
healthcode="import json,urllib.request;print(json.dumps({p:json.load(urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:"+str(c['fusion_http_port'])+"'+p,timeout=8)) for p in ['/readyz','/metrics']}))"
health=json.loads(run(['docker','exec',c['fusion_container'],'python','-c',healthcode]))
info=json.loads(run(['docker','inspect',c['fusion_container'],c['redis']['container']]))
group=run(['docker','exec',k['container'],'kafka-consumer-groups','--bootstrap-server',k['metadata_bootstrap'],'--describe','--group',k['group'],'--members','--verbose'])
state=run(['docker','exec',k['container'],'kafka-consumer-groups','--bootstrap-server',k['metadata_bootstrap'],'--describe','--group',k['group'],'--state'])
assert k['topics']['raw']+'(' in group and k['topics']['raw_events']+'(' in group
assert 'Stable' in state and all(x['State']['Running'] for x in info)
assert info[0]['Image']==c['processing_image']
assert not info[0]['HostConfig']['PortBindings'] and not info[1]['HostConfig']['PortBindings']
probe="import json;from app.core.config import settings as s;print(json.dumps({k:getattr(s,k) for k in ['alert_store_schema','event_promotion_enabled','detection_engine_enabled','windowed_detection_enabled','ueba_fusion_enabled','correlation_window_seconds','max_alerts_per_incident','clickhouse_database','kafka_consumer_group','lake_writer_enabled','alert_sink_enabled']}))"
loaded=json.loads(run(['docker','exec',c['fusion_container'],'python','-c',probe]))
assert loaded['alert_store_schema']=='socai2' and loaded['correlation_window_seconds']==int(c['fusion_env']['CORRELATION_WINDOW_SECONDS'])
p=c['postgres']
counts=json.loads(run(['docker','exec','-i',p['container'],'psql','-XwAtq','-U',p['admin_role'],'-d',p['database']],"SELECT json_build_object('alerts',(SELECT count(*) FROM socai2.alerts),'incidents',(SELECT count(*) FROM socai2.incidents),'cases',(SELECT count(*) FROM socai2.cases),'tasks',(SELECT count(*) FROM socai2.analysis_tasks),'attempts',(SELECT count(*) FROM socai2.analysis_attempts),'runs',(SELECT count(*) FROM socai2.runs),'dead_letters',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.aisoc_dead_letters));"))
assert counts['alerts']==3 and counts['incidents']==1 and counts['tasks']==4 and counts['cases']==counts['attempts']==counts['runs']==0

retired=json.loads(run(['docker','inspect','socai2-streaming-fusion-20261115-r2-stopped']))[0]
assert not retired['State']['Running']
print(json.dumps({'status':'passed','observed_at':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'candidate_id':c['candidate_id'],'tenant_id':c['identity']['tenant_id'],'target':c['ssh_target'],'scope':'resources_r3_ready_failed_batch_retained_no_models','health':health,'containers':[{'name':x['Name'].lstrip('/'),'id':x['Id'],'image_id':x['Image'],'running':x['State']['Running'],'host_ports':x['HostConfig']['PortBindings']} for x in info],'kafka_group':group,'kafka_group_state':state,'kafka_topics':k['topics'],'loaded_settings':loaded,'database_counts':counts,'models_enabled':False,'dispatcher_enabled':False,'model_calls':0,'new_version_messages_sent':0,'previous_batch_retained':True},indent=2))
